newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada says Saudi was a driver in Saudi bombing.
newsitem.headline: Canada says Saudi was a driver in Saudi bombing.

text.p: The Canadian government charged on Thursday that one of two Saudi dissidents it is holding was a driver involved in the truck bombing in Saudi Arabia last June that killed 19 U.S. airmen.

In documents filed with the Federal Court, Canada's intelligence service alleged that Hani Abdel-Rahim Hussein al-Sayegh conducted surveillance at the site of the bombing and then drove a car which "signalled the explosives-laden truck to enter the parking lot."
